STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast tray with cereal, yogurt, fruit, coffee, bread, mushrooms, a fried egg, and honey. Photographed from a front-on, slightly elevated angle, on a tray at a seat.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The dinner plate is about 22 cm in diameter (the bread and egg plate is a standard side/dinner plate, roughly 22 cm). Area = 3.14 x (11)^2 ≈ 380 cm^2. The cereal bowl is about 15 cm across, area ≈ 177 cm^2. The small fruit bowl is about 9 cm across.

STEP 3 - Items: granola/oat cereal with raisins (cereal bowl), plain yogurt cup (about 150 g container, roughly 3/4 eaten? No, it appears full), strawberries (small bowl), coffee (cup, mostly liquid), sourdough bread slice, mushrooms (about 3 caps), fried egg, honey packet (about 10 g).

STEP 4 - Area (of the plate and bowls):
- Cereal (granola with raisins) in bowl: fills ~70% of the 177 cm^2 bowl ≈ 124 cm^2, height ~1.5 cm → 186 ml × 0.5 (dry, airy granola) ≈ 93 g. Granola ~450 kcal/100 g → ~420 kcal.
- Bread slice: ~25% of plate ≈ 95 cm^2, height ~2 cm → 190 ml × 0.3 ≈ 57 g. Bread ~265 kcal/100 g → ~150 kcal.
- Fried egg: ~12% of plate ≈ 45 cm^2, height ~1.5 cm → 68 ml × 0.95 ≈ 65 g. Fried egg ~196 kcal/100 g → ~127 kcal.
- Mushrooms (3 caps, ~3 cm each): ~5% ≈ 19 cm^2, height ~2 cm → 38 ml × 0.6 ≈ 23 g. Cooked mushroom ~28 kcal/100 g → ~6 kcal.
- Strawberries in small bowl: ~50 cm^2 area of a 64 cm^2 bowl, height ~2 cm → 100 ml × 0.6 ≈ 60 g. Strawberries ~32 kcal/100 g → ~19 kcal.
- Yogurt (cup, about 150 g, fully visible, plain whole-milk style): 150 g × 0.9... contains ~61 kcal/100 g → ~92 kcal.
- Coffee with a little milk: ~150 ml × 0.99 ≈ 150 g × 2 kcal/100 g ≈ 3 kcal (black-ish with small milk).
- Honey packet: ~10 g × 304 kcal/100 g ≈ 30 kcal.

STEP 5-6 - Weights are as listed above, totalling roughly 93 + 57 + 65 + 23 + 60 + 150 + 150 + 10 ≈ 608 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: ≈ 420 + 150 + 127 + 6 + 19 + 92 + 3 + 30 ≈ 847 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A full breakfast tray with cereal, yogurt, bread, egg and fruit of about 600 g and roughly 850 kcal is plausible for this visible spread.
